bio.text: Aaron Flint is a Republican candidate for Montana's 1st Congressional District; the Associated Press projected on June 2, 2026 that he won the Republican primary, and the general election is November 3, 2026.
He has hosted statewide radio talk shows since 2009, including Montana Talks, and took a leave of absence from the show to campaign.
He is an Army veteran and a first-time candidate, and he and his family moved from Billings to Kalispell in 2025.

sources.title: Talk show host Flint to win GOP nomination for Congress
